localChanges: The Adjust trade rates window has been redesigned. Each rate is now one compact row with its icon, a slider, its percentage and a padlock to hold it while the others move, under a bar showing the split, and it fits a phone's width.

As you move the rates, the window shows what they give each turn: gold, research and the turns to the next advance, and how many cities would be in disorder, beside what they were. OK keeps the new rates; Cancel, Escape or closing the window puts back the rates you started with (closes #1058).
Moving one trade rate up while another sits at 0 now takes it as far as you drag it, rather than stopping short.

With automatic end of turn on, the turn now waits while the Adjust trade rates window is open and until the rates you leave are applied, so it can't end mid-adjustment once a city's disorder clears. Ending the turn with the window open keeps the rates on screen.
While the other civilizations are moving, the Adjust trade rates window shows the rates but can't change them until your turn begins.
